items.title: Lap
items.notes: Lap is a local-first, AI-powered photo manager designed for efficient image organization and searching. Digital creators and photographers can use it to securely catalog, sort, and navigate large media libraries using modern AI capabilities without relying on cloud services.

items.title: Deskboard - Where Folders Become Beautiful Workspaces
items.notes: Deskboard is a desktop organization tool that transforms standard folders into customizable visual workspaces complete with widgets, notes, and annotations. Game developers and digital creators can use it to visually manage project files, reference materials, and work-in-progress assets directly on their desktop.

items.title: GitHub - Eul45/omni-search: High-performance Windows file search + duplicate finder using NTFS USN/MFT, with Android LAN sync. Built with Tauri, Rust, C++, and Kotlin.
items.notes: Omni-search is a high-performance Windows file search and duplicate finder utilizing low-level NTFS USN/MFT mechanics with Android LAN synchronization. Developers and power users can leverage its Tauri, Rust, C++, and Kotlin architecture as a powerful reference for building lightning-fast cross-platform desktop and mobile utilities.

items.title: GitHub - justnullname/QuickView: The fastest Direct2D-powered image viewer for Windows. Features multi-threaded JXL/AVIF decoding, GPU acceleration, and a borderless geek UI. Supports WebP, RAW, & QOI with visual settings and auto-updates. Portable & SIMD-optimized.
items.notes: QuickView is an ultra-fast, Direct2D-powered image viewer for Windows designed with GPU acceleration and multi-threaded decoding for modern formats like JXL, AVIF, and WebP. Digital creators and developers can use it to instantly preview high-resolution assets and RAW files without interface bloat.

items.title: https://windhawk.net/mods/alt-tab-delayer
items.notes: A Windhawk customization mod for Windows that introduces a configurable delay before showing the Alt+Tab task switcher interface. It helps creators and developers eliminate visual clutter and overlay flicker during fast window switching across multiple production tools.

items.title: OmniClip - Clipboard Sync for PC & Android
items.notes: OmniClip is a secure utility that syncs clipboard history between Windows and Android devices over local WiFi without using the cloud. Developers and digital creators can use it to seamlessly transfer text, links, and code snippets across devices during their workflow.

items.title: GitHub - Tox-EyE-CeaZY/Hearth at widgets-and-installer
items.notes: Hearth is an open-source Windows desktop replacement designed with an Android-inspired aesthetic and modular widget support. Power users and creators can use it to replace the default Windows shell with a streamlined, mobile-like workspace interface.

items.title: GitHub - hyperfield/ai-file-sorter: Cross-platform desktop application for content-aware file organization and renaming. Supports local and remote LLMs, preview-based workflows, and fully user-controlled changes.
items.notes: AI File Sorter is an open-source cross-platform desktop application that automatically categorizes and renames files based on their content using local or cloud LLMs. Digital creators and developers can streamline messy project directories and asset libraries using its safe, preview-first workflow.

items.title: The Most Powerful File Explorer Replacement on the Market: Directory Opus
items.notes: Directory Opus is an advanced, highly customizable file manager replacement for Windows designed to supercharge file organization and workflow efficiency. It enables power users and creators to handle complex file operations, batch processing, and dual-pane browsing with speed and precision.

items.title: The File Explorer Replacement You've Been Waiting For - File Pilot
items.notes: File Pilot is an advanced file manager and Windows Explorer alternative designed to streamline file organization and workflow efficiency. It empowers digital creators and tech enthusiasts to navigate directories, manage assets, and execute batch operations much faster than the default OS interface.

items.title: The Windows Search Replacement - The Everything Search Tool!
items.notes: Everything by voidtools is an ultra-fast file searching utility for Windows that instantly indexes and locates files and folders by name. It serves as a powerful replacement for the default Windows Search, enabling digital creators and power users to retrieve assets and documents in milliseconds.

items.title: The Secrets of VLC Media Player - 15 Features You NEED to Know!
items.notes: VLC Media Player is a free, open-source cross-platform multimedia player capable of playing virtually any media format without external codecs. Beyond standard playback, it provides creators and power users with built-in tools for audio/video conversion, screen recording, stream capture, and subtitle synchronization.
